# Naming Convention

NEXT_PUBLIC_*     → Client-side (web, stream, mobile)
SUPABASE_*        → Supabase (URL, KEY, SERVICE_KEY)
SORAKU_*          → Soraku API (URL, SECRET)
DB_*              → Database (URL, STREAM_URL)
REDIS_*           → Cache (URL, TOKEN)
XENDIT_*          → Payment
TRAKTEER_*        → Donation
LAVA_*            → Lavalink
DISCORD_*         → Discord (sebagai prefix) atau langsung: TOKEN, CLIENT_ID, GUILD_ID
